subject: POC trial environment & success criteria - Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial environment & success criteria - Acme Analytics

Hi Alex / Samira -

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation and clear alignment on what Acme is trying to validate. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get the trial on the calendar.

High-level POC goals / success criteria (as discussed):
- Functional: integrate Redwood inference into Acme's ingestion pipeline and run a 2-week test set (5k-10k requests/day) with no functional regressions vs your control model.
- Quality: achieve parity or improvement on your QA pass rate and top-line precision/recall metrics (we'll confirm exact metrics with your ML lead).
- Performance: p95 latency <= 200ms for 512-token requests (we can adjust depending on your request mix).
- Cost: demonstrable unit economics (target: cost per 1M tokens under USD value to be confirmed in the SOW).

Environment options for trial (tradeoffs and timelines):
1) Hosted trial (fastest) - Redwood hosted API, shared infrastructure with tenant isolation, minimal setup. Good for quick functional validation. Can start in ~3 business days after SOW.
2) Dedicated sandbox - isolated tenant in our cloud with reserved capacity (predictable throughput, better performance isolation). Provisioning / infra setup typically 7-10 business days after SOW and network info.
3) VPC/private deployment - full VPC peering or Private Connect with customer-controlled networking and private control plane. Best for strict security/compliance but needs security review and ~4-6 weeks to provision.

Proposed timeline & ownership:
- Decision on environment (Alex) - confirm preference by EOW (6/30).
- SOW & PO (Marissa / Rishi) - I will draft the POC SOW and send for signature once you confirm environment.
- Network & test data (Acme) - provide test data sample and firewall/IP allowlist if needed (contact: Samira).
- Provisioning (Neha / Vivek) - infra and SRE tasks once SOW signed.

Attachments: I attached a draft POC SOW, network requirements spreadsheet, and a short checklist.

Next steps: please confirm which environment you prefer (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC) and your preferred kickoff week (we suggested July 6-13 windows). Once confirmed we’ll route the SOW for signature and queue provisioning.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the clear options. A few clarifications from our side: we want to validate both quality and latency. For latency, p95 <= 200ms is a good starting point. For quality we'll confirm exact evaluation metrics but expect model fidelity across our 3 core intents.

Prefer Dedicated sandbox for this POC (isolation + consistent perf). Can you confirm:
- What network changes will Acme need to make (IP ranges / egress rules)?
- Do you support private peering if we need stricter separation later?
- Rough estimate of infra costs for a 2-week trial (ballpark is fine for now).

Kickoff - can we target week of July 13 to give our infra/security team a week to review?

If you can send a revised SOW with Dedicated sandbox selected and the expected start date, we'll expedite sign-off.

Thanks - Alex

Thanks Marissa / Alex - quick technical notes re: Dedicated sandbox provisioning and what we need from Acme: 

What "Dedicated sandbox" means for this POC:
- Redwood will provision an isolated tenant in our cloud with dedicated GPU pool and network ACLs (no co-tenanted compute).
- No VPC peering by default - traffic goes over public egress unless customer requests Private Connect / peering.

What we need from Acme to provision quickly:
- Signed SOW / PO (provisioning ticket opened once signed).
- A list of test endpoints and/or sample payloads (for warmup and performance testing).
- If you want private connectivity: indicate preference for VPC peering or PrivateLink - that will move this to the VPC path and add ~3-4 weeks.
- Network changes (if you prefer to keep traffic restricted): allowlist the following Redwood egress IP ranges (see attached Network_Requirements.xlsx) and provide any outbound proxy details.

Timeline estimate (Dedicated sandbox):
- After SOW signed + network info: 7-10 business days to fully provision and validate with smoke tests.
- If Private Connect/VPC peering requested: add 3-4 weeks (security review + routing).

I attached the Network_Requirements.xlsx and a short checklist. If July 13 kickoff works for Acme, we should aim to have SOW in flight by next week (7/6) so infra can provision.

I’ll follow up with a provisioning playbook and sample test harness.

Thanks,
